payload.text: 0595 LANDED at c775f61ef and its staged_version follow-up LANDED at 7ee4fedd5, each on vc's judgement, each landed patch-id the bank's (9dd962b6599e; 5f14289d2f16): shared/rusthost.lib's rust_host is the one reader of rustc -vV's host for cmd/linux and cmd/macos and refuses by name when rustc is absent, fails, or names no host; linux doctor lists rustc among its lacks and takes its triple from uname only when rustc is absent; staged_version refuses by name when the staged binary is missing or does not run, carrying its stderr. releasebuild.lib:166 device_of is unreachable and stays, on vc's word. 0595 STAYS OPEN until kovacs runs tests/unit/linux_doctor.bats on Linux, a light order vc sends once hv's permission rule is in. NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.
